verdict.rationale: Portkey documents a REST API reference (base URL, headers, SDK compatibility) at /docs/api-reference, but the evidence pack contains no mention of an interactive explorer or runnable code examples, and probes for a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404s. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console, runnable code snippets, and a published OpenAPI/Swagger schema.
